title: 2016 SuffOC League
text:
The 2016 SuffOC League has now been finalised and congratulations are due to the Harrison family, to Will for winning the Senior League & to Tim for the Junior section.

Congratulations also to Sarah & Sally for coming 2nd & 3rd respectively in the Seniors, & to Matthew, Bryn & Theo for achieving 2nd & 3rd= in the Juniors. The completed League spreadsheet can be seen here and details of the League can be found within our "About SuffOC" section.
